subject: Q2 OKR convergence + QBR readiness / prep checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.h@acmecorp.com>, Product Ops <ops@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 OKR convergence + QBR readiness / prep checklist

Hi Amira / Acme Product Ops —

Thanks again for the tight timeline on the QBR. We're kicking off an internal convergence on the Q2 OKRs this week to make sure the metrics we present match the runway and the product roadmap you and Mark flagged last quarter. Attached is a working draft of the OKR sheet (2026_Q2_OKR-draft.xlsx) and a one-page QBR prep checklist.

Can you confirm the following so we can finalize by Tuesday: 1) the success metric you want emphasized for the partner integration (is it API calls/day, activation rate, or revenue attribution?), 2) whether the new data-retention requirement from legal is in scope for this QBR, and 3) any slides that Acme wants on the partnership section (we can embed up to 2 bespoke slides).

Proposed next steps:
- Internal alignment meeting: Mon 5/18 10:00 PT (internal only) to finalize the metrics we’ll surface.
- Dry run with Acme: Tue 5/19 11:00 PT.

If that timeline works, Laura and I will lock the final OKR numbers on Monday and circulate the final packet.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
(attachment: 2026_Q2_OKR-draft.xlsx)
(attachment: QBR-prep-checklist.md)

From: Amira Hassan <amira.h@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Product Ops <ops@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Mark Reynolds <m.reynolds@venturebridge.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 OKR convergence + QBR readiness / prep checklist

Thanks Ben —

We appreciate the proactive timeline. Quick answers: 1) Primary metric — activation-to-first-API-call within 7 days (we track that per cohort); secondary metric is partner-sourced revenue for the quarter. 2) The retention change is still under review by Acme legal; flag it in the notes but you don’t need to make it a blocker for the QBR slides. 3) We’ll send one slide with the integration roadmap and one slide with the success case studies (expected by EOD Mon).

Also, can you add a short note in the packet about fallback behavior and SLA tiers for the first 30 days post-launch? Our ops folks will want those spelled out.

—Amira
Amira Hassan
Head of Product Partnerships
AcmeCorp
(Amira cell: +1 415-555-0142)

Subject: Re: Q2 OKR convergence + QBR readiness / prep checklist

Team —

Amira confirmed metrics and wants an SLA/fallback blurb. Laura, I’ve attached the current OKR draft; please fold in the activation-to-first-API-call target under Objective 2 and mark the confidence level for the projection. Karthik — please include a short appendix on fallback behavior (we can reuse the standard Dedicated fallback text, 3 bullets). Aditya — quick ask: can you run updated revenue forecast (baseline and downside) and drop it into the "forecast" tab by 1pm PT?

We’ll meet at 10:00 PT to finalize the packet before the dry run. Agenda: 1) metric reconciliation, 2) slide ownership, 3) QBR storyteller notes (who speaks to what).

Ben

Subject: Re: Q2 OKR convergence + QBR readiness / prep checklist

Ben / team —

Thanks — I reviewed the OKR sheet and made inline edits (see attached v2). Key changes:
- Objective 1: tightened the leading indicators to MRR-qualified leads/week instead of total leads (see rationale in comments).
- Objective 2: added the activation-to-first-API-call (target: 45% within 7 days) and marked confidence as medium.
- Confidence: added a confidence column per key result so execs can see risk at a glance.

Constraint note: engineering is flagging reduced bandwidth for the new retention change; that should be called out in the QBR notes as a risk for the adoption curve.

I’ll be on the 10:00 PT meeting with pre-populated slides for the partner section.

Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
(attachment: 2026_Q2_OKR-draft_v2.xlsx)

Quick update — updated revenue forecast uploaded to the shared Drive (file: Q2_forecast_updated.xlsx). Baseline and downside scenarios added; downside assumes a 15% uplift in churn if retention work slips. I flagged the variance cells in red.

SGTM on the process this morning — just want to ensure we leave a 48h buffer before the dry run so we can iterate on feedback from Amira’s slide.

Subject: Final OKR packet ready for dry run (Tue 5/19 11:00 PT) — please review

Amira / team —

We’ve incorporated your asks and internal edits. Key callouts in the packet:
- Objective 1: lead qualification metric updated (see slide 3)
- Objective 2: partner activation target set to 45% within 7 days (slide 5)
- Risk: retention legal change noted; fallback behavior and SLA tiers included in appendix (Karthik)
- Forecast: baseline and downside included (Aditya)

Attachments: final OKR packet (PDF), QBR slide deck (deck link included), and checklist. Please review before Tue 11:00 PT; if we don’t hear edits by Tue 9:00 PT we’ll assume sign-off and proceed with the dry run.

Thanks — looking forward to the run-through.
